candidate.blueprint_topic: Psychosocial Integrity — Mental Health Concepts / schizotypal personality pattern
candidate.educational_objective: Differentiate schizotypal personality disorder from schizoid personality disorder by recognizing eccentric behavior plus cognitive or perceptual distortions in addition to social deficits.

options.A: Social and interpersonal deficits accompanied by eccentric behavior, odd beliefs or magical thinking, and unusual perceptual experiences
options.B: Social detachment and limited emotional expression without prominent cognitive or perceptual distortions
options.C: An excessive need for care that produces submissive and clinging behavior
options.D: A pervasive pattern of grandiosity and need for admiration

candidate.rationale: NCBI StatPearls describes schizotypal personality disorder as social/interpersonal deficits and difficulty with close relationships occurring with eccentric behavior and cognitive or perceptual distortions. Features may include odd beliefs or magical thinking and unusual perceptual experiences. Schizoid personality disorder is characterized more by detachment and emotional coldness without those prominent cognitive/perceptual distortions. Therefore A is the best answer.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Schizotypal personality disorder combines social/interpersonal deficits with eccentric behavior and cognitive or perceptual distortions such as magical thinking and unusual perceptual experiences.
